shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,280p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"onError|catch \\(\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md | head -100 && sed -n '1,160p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff HEAD -- . ':(exclude).lore/dod.md' && sed -n '1,130p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,210p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,70p' CHANGELOG.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#|@spec|spec:\" src/**/*.test.ts | head -80 && sed -n '270,325p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '130,165p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true && rg -n 'reanchor' scripts package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+#[0-9]+\" --glob '*.test.ts' --glob '*.spec.ts' . | head -50; rg -n \"spec anchor|VALIDATED_BY|validated by\" scripts .lore | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts && git diff --cached --check && git commit -m "fix(orchestrator): report non-Error rejections" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
